between_attempt_learning: HOLD ROUTE transitions to HOLD APPROACH; exposed coils can be tapped and fired on; status strip shows disabled coils. Captures clear contacts and AIM. Second run will sample map and manual view control rather than infer them from route completion.

review.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable, 7 good with material friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Scores are holistic judgments of observed use, not win/loss grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with clear recovery/boss/uplink feedback and accessible assistance. Small scene targets, dense HUD and uncertain precision limit the mobile impression. Both wins establish completion only.
reasons.controls: Large anchored MOVE/FIRE buttons, tap aiming and route/approach holds worked. Simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag and standalone scene turn were sampled. Guard tap did not always yield a clean engagement, bursts overshot kills, and sustained thumb precision/comfort is unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, exposed-coil timing and uplink hold supplied understandable progression; threat and hit direction cues helped. Assisted travel and repeated wait/fire cycles limited tested tactical variety; no inference about unplayed content or continuous enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber palette, rain, industrial silhouettes, weapon view and polished title/result screens formed a consistent atmosphere. Audio and hardware frame pacing unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/HOLD APPROACH, map legend, objective progression and transparent terminal assist stats helped. Multiple prompts compete on a narrow screen; route assistance does not establish independent navigation usability.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, big interaction buttons and boss/uplink status are legible at 390x844. Small world signs, dark structures and distant guards need more scrutiny; upper/lower prompt stacks crowd scene.

specific_frustrations: Side guard remained after attempted aim/fire and magazine ran dry

review.coverage_caveat: Not a full control suite review. No tools/settings changes; no AIM, dash or jump activation. No checkpoint retry and no third attempt.
